_comment: Operating points for the W2 downstream lm-eval (F5). Consumed by scripts/run_downstream_eval.sh and analysis/build_downstream_table.py. 'hf' points are loaded straight from an HF dir/hub-id; 'export' points are materialized once with seq_core.channel_sweep (--save_model_path) into a reloadable dense fake-quant checkpoint, then lm-eval'd. expected_ppl values are the WikiText-2 canonical PPLs from docs/PROJECT_STATUS_AND_ROADMAP.md §1 and are used only for a reload sanity check.

resmax_gptq.note: safe activation-magnitude protection on GPTQ (3B Pareto frontier point)

greedy_gptq.note: F3 probe: residual-driven greedy on GPTQ. Catastrophic in PPL and REPRODUCES on the regenerated base (63.95 on 1B / 51.68 on 3B) with verify_materialized delta~0 => not an export bug; but Llama-2-7B is healthy => F3 is model-dependent. Downstream-healthy is being closed by reloading the on-disk checkpoint - see FINDINGS_PAPER 7.2

best_hqq.note: best SEQ point on the data-free HQQ base (F1)

random_hqq.note: matched-bit random-channel control on HQQ (7.70 bits, seed 1234). Pairs with best_hqq for the matched-bit F1 test (paper 3). random_hqq{,_s2,_s3} give channel-set uncertainty.

random_hqq_s2.note: matched-bit random-channel control on HQQ, seed 2345 (2nd of 3 for channel-set uncertainty)

random_hqq_s3.note: matched-bit random-channel control on HQQ, seed 3456 (3rd of 3 for channel-set uncertainty)

Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B._note: cross-family breadth (paper § cross-family). expected_ppl.gptq4 from runs/final/llmc/Qwen2.5-3B/gptq/summary.json; the other expected_ppl are filled from the Qwen sweep once it lands (reload sanity only, not enforced during eval).

paired_contrasts.name: greedy_gptq_vs_gptq4
paired_contrasts.claim: F3 pre-registration (catastrophic on GPTQ) - FALSIFIED downstream, see FINDINGS_PAPER 7.2

paired_contrasts.name: best_hqq_vs_random_hqq
paired_contrasts.claim: matched-bit (7.70) activation-signal protection beats a random-channel control downstream (F1 sharpening, mirrors paper 3)
